extraction_notes: Target identity retained exactly from job metadata: AO3400, Guangdong Hottech, n-channel MOSFET.
The datasheet footer identifies SHENZHEN HOTTECH ELECTRONICS CO., LTD.; the manufacturer field remains the requested Guangdong Hottech identity.
The supplied PDF states no revision identifier.

RDS(ON) table rows are transcribed as inclusive maximum values: 28 mOhm at VGS = 10 V and ID = 5.8 A, 33 mOhm at VGS = 4.5 V and ID = 5 A, and 52 mOhm at VGS = 2.5 V and ID = 4 A; all are pulse-test rows with pulse width <= 300 us and duty cycle <= 0.5%.

The VSD table provides MIN = 0.7 V and MAX = 1 V at IS = 1 A and VGS = 0 V; the strict schema has one body_diode value, so the inclusive MAX value is used. The p. 2 typical 25 degC body-diode curve is also included.
Ciss and Crss have blank condition cells in the p. 1 table. Their conditions are not inferred; Coss retains the explicitly printed VDS = 15 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz condition.

Additional p. 1 tabulated fields not represented by the strict schema include VDS(max) = 30 V, VGS = +/-12 V, ID = 5.8 A at TA = 25 degC and 4.9 A at TA = 70 degC, IDM = 30 A, PD = 1.40 W at TA = 25 degC and 0.9 W at TA = 70 degC, gFS typ = 33 S, Rg = 1.5/3/4.5 ohm min/typ/max, Qg = 6/7 nC typ/max, Qgs typ = 1.3 nC, Qgd typ = 1.8 nC, trr typ = 8.5 ns, and Qrr typ = 2.6 nC; p. 1 citations.
Curve points are compact direct readings from the supplied typical plots on p. 2 and p. 3. No points were generated by interpolation between source values.
